title: Tesco order history was a dead REST stub
notes: getOrders()/getOrder() hit a webpage URL, not an API. Fixed via real GraphQL queries. See PR #16.

title: groc remove/update take the wrong ID for Tesco
notes: Documented as item_id, provider needed product_uid, silently no-op'd. Fixed in PR #16.

title: GetOrderReceipt returned today's catalogue price, not what was paid
notes: product.price was live-joined, not historical. Switched to splitView.items[].cost. Fixed in PR #16.

title: Audit Sainsbury's/Ocado for the same dead-order-history pattern
notes: Ocado's README claims GraphQL order history works - unverified, worth checking before relying on it.

title: Silent catch { return null } in tesco/api.ts hides real errors
notes: Made the order-history bug much harder to diagnose. A 500 looked identical to no orders.

title: Nutrition/protein data isn't in Tesco's product/order API
notes: Would need a separate lookup keyed off tpnb/tpnc/gtin. Real unknown, not assumed solvable with current data.

title: Preference/goals engine: CHEAP/MODERATE/PREMIUM tier toggle
notes: Formalize the manual per-category swap judgement calls made during basket sessions into a reusable dial. Speculative, prototype against real order history first.

title: Multi-provider spend aggregation
notes: Tesco + Sainsbury's + Ocado in one view. Needs at least two providers with working order history first (see #4).

title: Product stats (times_seen etc) must be derived, not incremented
notes: Incrementing during the sync loop double-counted on re-runs (beef mince showed 18x, real answer was 9). Fixed by recomputing from final order set each run.
